output.message: Base case: NPV £36,581, ROI 99%, payback 26.8 months. The spread runs from NPV £-57,638 and ROI -68% pessimistic to NPV £152,757 and ROI 348% optimistic. Saving per account per year moves the result most: base-case NPV is zero at £112.

The evidence supports a modest internal efficiency case: two finance assistants spend 41% of their time on reconciliation, and simple rules matched 82% of payments automatically. Base case NPV £36,581, ROI 99%, payback 26.8 months, but pessimistic NPV is £-57,638. Agents disagree on market pull and the partial-payment gap. A shadow run for £6,820 over 5 weeks would test matching rates before commitment. Policy indicates a pilot.
